facts: A06 provides a single-writer default XDG profile before Tauri startup.
A05/A05b provide an embedded SQLite profile and a storage-independent repository boundary.
The architecture forbids refresh tokens, board keys, device private keys and vault roots in plaintext SQLite/localStorage/config.
The initial SQLite schema already contains stable workspace and board identifiers but no human-readable titles.
inferences: The first honest UI vertical slice can persist workspace/board metadata without introducing card semantics scheduled for A08.
A session-only vault implementation proves the application secret-provider seam without silently claiming production at-rest protection.
proposals: Schema v2 adds additive workspace/board titles and requires reader/writer version 2 because the A05 binary rejects newer user_version values.
Typed Tauri IPC exposes workspace/board operations and read-only vault capability status only.
unresolved: Production Secret Service/KWallet/passphrase providers remain A09.
Remote HTTP authentication and device-link provisioning are not implemented by A07.
Cards, ordering, archive/delete, checklists and sync semantics remain A08+.
